v.n: NCIS: Origins Season 3 Trailer (HD) Gibbs prequel series

eps.o: Set in the present day, ghosts from the past of Leroy Jethro Gibbs finally catch up to him, shattering his peaceful retirement in Alaska. In 1992, the team races to rescue a kidnapped Randy while Gibbs and Lala deal with the aftermath of their kiss.
In 1992, the team bands together to help Woody when he’s accused of murdering a bowling rival. In the present, Gibbs returns to civilization and calls in a favor from old friend Woody.

In 1992, Dr. Donald “Ducky” Mallard helps the team investigate when a young Marine is found murdered on a beach with suspicious markings all over his body. In the present, Gibbs reunites with a familiar face from the past.

In 1993, the team intervenes when a general’s rebellious teen son is targeted by a dangerous former gang member. In the present, Gibbs returns to a place full of memories and discovers he’s not alone.
In 1993, the team’s investigation into the murder of a con woman hits close to home for Lala. In the present, Gibbs and Bishop team up for an intense interrogation.

eps.t: Don't Let the Days Go By
